title: University of Massachusetts Amherst
description: UMass Amherst's official brand colours define the main palette Maroon (#840028) and Black (#212721), the secondary colours Yellow (#FFC72C), Orange (#FF9E1B), Purple (#615E9B), Dark Green (#44693D), Brown (#5E4B3C), Dark Blue (#002554), Bright Blue (#00AEC7), Soft Green (#86C8BC), Leaf Green (#6BA539), Neon Green (#C4D600), Rust (#CB6015) and Bright Red (#FE3B1F), and the neutrals Dark Gray (#373A36), Medium Gray (#505759) and Light Gray (#A2AAAD).
